input_text: Funds keep vanishing from the books of a software group, so its founder Dhruv, a billionaire, quietly becomes the cleaner on the late shift. Lonely bookkeeper Smita starts chatting with him over cold coffee and begins to rely on him. While emptying bins after hours he reads the files and uncovers the head of accounts routing money to a dummy firm. The head of accounts senses the leak and pins the missing money on Smita. Dhruv secretly captures the head of accounts admitting everything on his phone. In an urgent session of directors he announces he owns the place, plays the clip and gets Smita cleared.
